messages.text: Repeat renters keep asking why we block the full deposit after five clean returns. Could a trust tier reduce the hold without presenting it as a loyalty coupon?
For low-confidence sizing, hold an adjacent size against the same wedding itinerary. Universal two-size ordering will destroy contribution margin.
Wedding customers plan haldi, mehendi, sangeet and reception looks. Campaign landing should start from an event itinerary, not a generic bundle discount.
Show when and how a garment was cleaned plus the warehouse inspection state. Professionally cleaned alone feels like marketing copy.
A repeat customer abandoned after a ₹4,500 hold on a ₹2,700 rental. Her last four returns were spotless.
An enterprise wedding planner wants one timeline for every outfit, accessory, delivery and return—not separate confirmations.
Three fit complaints were brand measurement mismatches. Customers asked whether the next size can be kept ready without two independent rentals.
Late returns came from confusion about courier pickup versus warehouse receipt. Reminder copy must use event date and pickup slot.
Rental search should hard-filter inventory that cannot finish inspection, cleaning and delivery before the event. Popularity ranks only feasible inventory.
Trust score features: successful returns, late-return rate, damage claim value, payment failures and account age. Return multiplier and reason codes.
